implementation_summary.description: Implemented a project-agnostic reference pack intake and canonicalization layer that separates reference asset management from project-specific hardcoding. The system provides a taxonomy-based slot structure, validation, canonicalization, and CLI commands for managing reference packs without visual acceptance or hardcoded project bindings.
key_features: Project-agnostic reference slot taxonomy with 12 predefined slots
JSON-based data models for reference pack, slots, assets, and policies
Canonicalization layer with SHA256 hashing and naming conventions
Validation layer enforcing no visual acceptance and no hardcoded paths
CLI commands for init, validate, inspect, and readiness reporting
Comprehensive test suite with 17 tests all passing

files_created.description: Data models for reference pack structures (ReferencePack, ReferenceSlot, ReferenceAsset, ReferenceUsagePolicy, ReferenceCanonicalizationReport)
Canonicalization logic with SHA256 hashing and naming conventions
Validation logic enforcing project-agnostic constraints and no visual acceptance
Intake layer for creating, loading, and saving reference packs
Taxonomy definition with 12 reference slots across 4 categories
CLI command implementations for reference pack management
Comprehensive test suite with 17 tests covering all components

files_modified.description: Added CLI subparsers and dispatch logic for reference pack commands

cli_commands_implemented.description: Initialize a new project-agnostic reference pack
Validate a reference pack structure and constraints
Inspect a reference pack and print its contents
Generate readiness report for reference pack

validate_command.output: Reference pack validated successfully with no errors

inspect_command.output: Reference pack inspected showing 12 slots in pending_operator_supply status

risks_and_notes: The system is designed to be project-agnostic and does not enforce file existence checks for future references
All slots are optional and marked as pending_operator_supply until assets are provided
The canonicalization layer generates naming templates but does not enforce file renaming
Validation prevents hardcoded project paths like 'rc2_multishot1_ep01' in asset file paths
next_steps: Operators can supply reference assets to populate the slots
The readiness report will update as assets are added
Future integration with generation pipelines can consume the reference pack manifest
Additional slot types can be added to the taxonomy as needed
